entry.title: BEST REACTION EVER! Teacher surprised with 2026 CMA Foundation Music Teacher of Excellence award

media:group.media:title: BEST REACTION EVER! Teacher surprised with 2026 CMA Foundation Music Teacher of Excellence award
media:group.media:description:
This week, we surprised Darlene Grande at Stonewyck Elementary School with some incredible news: she’s been named a 2026 CMA Foundation Music Teacher of Excellence!
Ms. Grande is one of just 30 educators nationwide recognized for the extraordinary way she uses music to inspire and connect with students. And what made the moment even sweeter? Two of her former students came back to help surprise her!
As part of this honor, she’ll receive a $5,000 award (split between her program and personal use) and be celebrated at a red carpet event in Nashville this fall. Congrats, Ms. Grande!
#ocps #WeAreOCPS #CMA #MusicEducation #publiceducation

entry.title: Schools Go Green: Inside OCPS Sustainability on Mondays with Maria presented by Addition Financial

media:group.media:title: Schools Go Green: Inside OCPS Sustainability on Mondays with Maria presented by Addition Financial
media:group.media:description:
In this episode Dr. Maria Vazquez talks with OCPS sustainability leaders about the district’s Sustainability Plan 2030, its five targets (waste, water, health & wellness, energy, and transportation), and real examples from schools like Ivey Lane, Magnolia, and Zellwood.
They discuss programs such as composting pilots, water-usage education, Energy Star-certified schools, electric buses and vans, and the Green School Recognition Program that celebrates student-driven sustainability efforts.

entry.title: Sembrando Semillas de Liderazgo: El Poder de Legacy MS

media:group.media:title: Sembrando Semillas de Liderazgo: El Poder de Legacy MS
media:group.media:description:
No se trata solo de una reunión después de clases; se trata de construir una armadura de confianza. En un mundo que a veces les dice que no pueden, este programa les susurra al oído: “Tú eres capaz, tú eres líder y tu voz importa”. 💖
Ver cómo estos estudiantes transforman su autoestima y descubren el poder que llevan dentro es la prueba más grande de que, con la guía correcta, el cielo es el límite. Estamos cultivando no solo estudiantes, sino los líderes, soñadores y agentes de cambio del mañana.
A veces, todo lo que un estudiante necesita para brillar es saber que alguien cree en el. Legacy MS es ese lugar seguro donde la esperanza se convierte en acción.
#LegacyMS #EmpoderamientoFemenino #LiderazgoJuvenil #Autoestima #GirlPower #Mentoria #FuturasLideres #OCPS #Comunidad #Esperanza

entry.title: How Magnet Programs Shape Careers on Mondays with Maria presented by Addition Financial

media:group.media:title: How Magnet Programs Shape Careers on Mondays with Maria presented by Addition Financial
media:group.media:description: Join OCPS Superintendent Dr. Maria Vazquez at Wekiva High School as she sits down with students to explore the Culinary Arts Magnet Program.
